title: Coastal Green Hydrogen Firm-Supply Data Package: Micro-Meteorological, Electrochemical & Techno-Economic Benchmark Repository (2005-2024)
description: Multi-decadal hourly meteorological records (ECMWF ERA5 and NASA POWER MERRA-2, 2005-2024), digitized peer-reviewed PEM water electrolyzer experimental polarization curves (Bernt & Gasteiger, Trinke, Rakousky), and Indian tender-grounded techno-economic benchmarks for islanded hybrid wind-solar green hydrogen production and process fault diagnosis.
